title: Longer frustrated caller
about: An escalating caller whose order has sat in 'preparing'; four turns of rising frustration.

turns.say: This is the third time I'm calling about order 45102. It's been stuck on 'preparing' for ages!
No, that's not good enough. I paid for a stand mixer weeks ago.
Fine. What exactly are you going to do about it, and by when?
If it isn't here by Friday I want a full refund, and I want that in writing.
